blockers.title: A staff line that names one person in a single word ('Istruttore: Verdani', 'Istruttore: L. Verdani', 'Istruttore: Wu Li') still starts the staff section, so every student below it disappears. This is a regression from 5c1e029, and the self-review says F1C-3 is fixed
blockers.scenario: Probes round6/parser.probe (S) and misc.probe (G), compared with the 5c1e029 parser. namesSomeone counts only words of three or more letters that are neither staff nor heading words, and it needs two of them. (a) Sheet: 'Allievi', 'Bardino Marco 12/03/2014 12 anni', 'Verdi Anna 01/02/2015 11 anni', 'Istruttore: L. Verdani', 'Rossa Ada 05/06/2016 10 anni', 'Neri Paolo 07/08/2015 11 anni'. The current parser returns only Bardino and Verdi. Rossa and Neri disappear with no notice, and the camera path has no count confirmation to catch it. The baseline returns all four. 'Istruttore: Verdani', 'Istruttore Verdani' and 'Istruttore: Wu Li' drop the same students. (b) Sheet: 'Elenco partecipanti', 'Istruttore: Verdani', then three students. The result is 0 candidates, marked unsuitable. The baseline read 3 ready students. At 5c1e029 the section pattern (istruttr…) did not match 'Istruttore', and PERSONNEL_ROW_PREFIX_PATTERN skipped the line on its own. The round-4 F1F-3 regex fix turned such a line into a section start. The round-5 fix exempts only lines with two long name words. 'Istruttrice: Anna' and 'Assistente: Neri' behave the same way (they already did at baseline). SC-11 says 'a staff line that also names someone … is skipped alone and does not start it'. That is false for these lines, and next steps does not list the case. This matches the F1F-1 pattern: a claimed fix that still drops students with no notice.
blockers.suggestedFix: Decide from the keyword's form, not from a word count. A line that starts with a singular role word (the PERSONNEL_ROW_PREFIX_PATTERN words: istruttore, istruttrice, assistente, responsabile …) is that person's own row: skip it alone, whatever follows. Only a collective word (istruttori, istruttrici, personale, staff, assistenti, volontari, segreteria) may start the section, and only when nothing but particles, staff words and heading words follows it. Otherwise skip the line and mark the rows after it possible-staff until a student heading, as a dated staff heading already does. Add tests for 'Istruttore: Verdani', 'Istruttore: L. Verdani' and 'Istruttore: Wu Li', both above and between students.

importantFindings.title: namesSomeone counts particles and filler words as names, so 'Personale del turno', 'Assistenti del turno' and 'Staff del Centro Velico' no longer start the staff section. Staff rows below them without a role code become ready with no mark. At baseline they were dropped
importantFindings.scenario: Probe round6/parser.probe P. Sheet: three students, then 'Personale del turno', then 'Verdani Luca 03/04/1990 36 anni' and 'Neri Sara 05/05/1995 31 anni'. Current result: both staff rows are READY with no rowWarning. Baseline: both dropped. The same happens for 'Assistenti del turno' and 'Staff del Centro Velico'. 'del' (a surname particle of three letters) and 'turno', 'centro' and 'velico' each count as a name word. 'Personale di turno' and 'Istruttori di turno' still work only because 'di' has two letters. Staff rows that carry a role code are still dropped or marked. This concerns rows without one, the class F1F-3 rated important.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: The fix for F1R6-1 also fixes this. At minimum, leave SURNAME_PARTICLES and non-name filler words out of the count. When in doubt, mark the rows after the line possible-staff instead of accepting them.

importantFindings.title: An age-range heading whose first word is not a heading keyword is still read as a ready student. This already happened at 5c1e029
importantFindings.scenario: Probe round6/parser.probe H and HL. 'Gruppo Vela 8-12 anni' or 'Turno Vela 10-14 anni' above three students, both text-only and laid out as a table. Result: surname Gruppo (or Turno), given name Vela, age 12 (or 14), sex female, no rowWarning, READY after the sheet's name-order vote. The row is saved with 'Aggiungi N allievi'. The baseline behaves the same, so this is not a regression. However, the new rule's own comment says an age range 'describes a course, never one person', yet the rule applies only after a heading word. Next steps does not list it. Side effect: a heading centred to the right of the name column now produces an empty-name row with age 12. That row waits for review and can be removed. The baseline dropped it.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: When AGE_RANGE_PATTERN matches, mark the row possible-heading (return 'row-led-by-heading-word') whatever its first word is, or skip it. Add a test with 'Gruppo Vela 8-12 anni'.

qolFindings.title: Neither document lists what happens to a student whose given name is a keyword and is printed second, as it is on a surname-first roster
qolFindings.scenario: Probe round6/misc.probe K. On a tight crop with no table layout, 'Rossi Domenica 12/03/2014' with no printed age is dropped with no notice. The baseline does the same. The roster prints the surname first, so this is how a girl named Domenica appears. The next-steps bullet covers only names that start with a heading word, and the S4 note covers only keyword surnames. With a table layout the row is kept.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Word the bullet as 'a heading word anywhere in the name cell' for the case with no layout and no age. Alternatively, on that path keep and mark a row with two name words and a date that could be a birth date.

qolFindings.title: Remaining gaps in the F1C-4 rule
qolFindings.scenario: Probe round6/parser.probe C. (a) Sheet: 'Istruttori di turno tel. 3331234567' at the top, then 'Verdani Luca 03/04/1990 36 anni', 'Allievi', then students. The staff row is READY with no mark, as at baseline. The self-review describes this rule accurately. (b) Sheet: 'Registro aggiornato al 20/08/2026', then 'Segreteria didattica: 0212345678', then students. The title is read as a candidate with a date, so the contact line marks all three students possible-staff. This errs on the safe side and only adds review taps.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Count only earlier candidates whose date could be a birth date (couldBeBirthDate, age 4 or more) or whose age is plausible.

qolFindings.title: Two small overstatements in the history-rewrite wording
qolFindings.scenario: Question 1 says check:repository is 'part of every verification'. package.json runs it in verify:domain, verify and verify:all, but not in verify:quick or verify:e2e. The CI comment says the full fetch lets check:repository 'refuse a push'. The same question correctly says CI only reports after a push.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Write 'part of npm run verify and verify:all', and in the CI comment write 'detect' instead of 'refuse'.

The em dash, '8/12', '8 12' and 'dagli 8 ai 12' variants, 'Settimana Deriva 12 anni' and 'Sabato Marco 12 anni' are kept and marked possible-heading, and none becomes ready. It says the Codex worktree and refs/codex/* have neither, and that CI reports after a push and cannot prevent one. It asks the owner to delete the worktree and refs/codex/* before the next Codex session. 'Where this cycle stands' in 04 states the same precondition for UG2. The AGENTS.md §13 text matches the guard and CI's fetch-depth 0. A read-only check shows the Codex worktree still at fcdf42f and two refs/codex/* entries; deleting them is the owner's action. Wording nits: F1R6-6.

Fixed only for lines with two long name words ('Istruttore: Verdani Luca': tests at :1404-1423, probes agree). A single name word, an initial or short names still start the section and drop the students after it (F1R6-1). Filler words now stop staff headings from starting it (F1R6-2).

'Personale al 29/08/2026' at the top now marks the staff row below it possible-staff. The heading itself is kept and marked. A stray title without a date no longer arms a contact line. A contact line at the top marks nothing, and one in the middle of the sheet marks the rows after it. Tests are at :1437-1470. Residuals: F1R6-5.

Entries must now be full 40-character hex ids (check-repository.mjs:293-299). A missing object still counts as not an ancestor, which is acceptable with full history. A missing file still passes. The self-review records this as partly fixed. check:repository passes on this tree.

The bullet at 1_0_0_NEXT_STEPS.md:100-108 matches classifyLine for names that start with a heading word. A single printed age gives a marked row. In a table, a date or telephone beside two or more name words gives a marked row. An age range drops the row. With no age read, the row is dropped when there is no layout, no date or telephone, only one name word, or a date that cannot be a birth date. Doc gap for a keyword given name printed second: F1R6-4.
